channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Austria: Startstipendien for Visual Art, Design, Photography and Media Art 2027 (BMWKMS) (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Austrian Federal Ministry for Arts and Culture (BMWKMS)
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: 23 grants of EUR 9,000 for six months, plus EUR 200 per month for single parents or families on increased family allowance (EUR 400 if both apply). No application fee.

Start-up grants from the Austrian arts ministry for emerging artists, with media art as one of four named disciplines alongside visual art, design and photography (apply in one discipline only).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ETC Digital Theatre Programme: Research and Development Sprints 2027-28 (cross-border theatre and digital artist teams) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
European Theatre Convention (ETC) with the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität, Dortmund
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,000 development grant shared between the two partner theatres, plus up to EUR 2,860 from ETC for the Digital Expert's travel, accommodation and subsistence. The theatres must put the Digital Expert on their payroll at their usual creative fee. No application fee.

ETC's Digital Theatre Programme pairs two member theatres from different countries with a Digital Expert to research and develop artistic uses of technology in theatre: motion capture, coding, mixed, augmented and virtual reality, robotics and interaction design.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: H401 WONDER open call: 4-week artist residency in Amsterdam on women in the European Resistance (EUR 3,000 fee plus production budget) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
H401 (Stichting Herengracht 401), within the EU-funded WONDER project led by ECCOM
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: Artist fee of EUR 3,000, production costs reimbursed up to EUR 1,000, plus travel, accommodation (if applicable) and subsistence under EU travel guidelines. Travel and accommodation for the final event in Rome are also covered. No application fee stated.

Women Narratives during the European Resistance (WONDER) is a 15-month EU project (CERV programme) in five countries; each partner hosts one artist, and this is the Dutch call, for 1 artist.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Planetary Transitions 2027: Potsdam Artist Residency (EUR 2,500/month, 4 to 6 months at a sustainability research institute) (closes 7 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) at GFZ, with the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program
Deadline: 7 Feb 2027
Award: Monthly stipend of EUR 2,500, plus a lump sum for travel to Potsdam and back, and up to EUR 5,000 housing support if you stay in Potsdam. No application fee stated.

An art-science residency that brings an international artist into the Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) in Potsdam to work alongside researchers on sustainability and planetary transitions. Run since 2025 by RIFS at GFZ, the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Schloss Wiepersdorf Individual and Collaborative Fellowships 2028 (Brandenburg; EUR 1,200/month plus room and board) (closes 15 Apr 2027)
item.description:
Schloss Wiepersdorf (state of Brandenburg)
Deadline: 15 Apr 2027, 23:59 CEST
Award: EUR 1,200 per month stipend, a one-time EUR 480 material grant, room and board, and German visa costs where needed. No application fee.

Three-month residential fellowships at Schloss Wiepersdorf for artists, writers, composers and scholars from Germany and abroad. Fellows get room, board, a EUR 1,200 monthly stipend and a material grant; fine artists get a studio where space allows.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: KB Fellowship at NIAS 2027-2028 (National Library of the Netherlands collections incl. born-digital; artists and researchers) (closes 15 Mar 2027)
item.description:
NIAS-KNAW (Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study) with the KB, National Library of the Netherlands
Deadline: 15 Mar 2027, 12:00 CET
Award: Personal stipend (figure not published); scholars at Dutch institutions get a Dutch University Grant paid to their institution instead. Office, subsidised Amsterdam housing where eligible (otherwise local transport reimbursement). No application fee.

One fellowship a year for work with the KB's collections, facilities and expertise, including its large digitised and born-digital holdings.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Weizenbaum Institute: Affiliated Fellowship with a research group (Berlin; EUR 3,000 to 5,000/month, rolling)
item.description:
Weizenbaum Institute for the Networked Society
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Monthly allowance of EUR 3,000 (doctoral), EUR 4,000 (postdoc incl. assistant/associate professors) or EUR 5,000 (professors); EUR 2,500 / 3,500 if salary continues. Plus EUR 500/month child allowance and a travel lump sum of EUR 200 (Germany), 500 (Europe) or 1,200 (outside Europe). No application fee.

Short guest fellowships embedded in Weizenbaum Institute research groups working on platforms, digital society, AI and technology. ELIGIBILITY: researchers from doctoral candidates upward; artists are not mentioned.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie: Open Call Cultural Education and Digital Technology 2026 (closes 16 Dec)
item.description:
Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie (with LKCA and DEN)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 to EUR 25,000 per project, up to 100% of total project costs (no co-funding required). Total budget EUR 500,000.

Open call (Open Oproep Cultuureducatie en Digitale Technologie) for cultural education projects in which children and young people work creatively with digital technology. Run by the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie with LKCA and DEN.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IJ4EU Freelancer Support Scheme 2026-27, Second Call (cross-border teams of freelance journalists) (closes 2 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU): International Press Institute and European Journalism Centre
Deadline: 2 Feb 2027
Award: Up to EUR 20,000 per team, plus training and mentoring.

A strand of IJ4EU for freelance journalists: teams of at least two freelancers in two eligible countries receive funding, training and mentoring for a cross-border investigation.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IJ4EU Investigation Support Scheme 2026-27, Second Call (cross-border investigative journalism) (closes 2 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU): International Press Institute and European Journalism Centre
Deadline: 2 Feb 2027
Award: EUR 5,000 to 50,000 per project, from a EUR 1.2 million pot.

IJ4EU funds cross-border investigative journalism in the public interest, by teams of journalists and newsrooms working across at least two eligible countries. Eligibility is by country of residence, not citizenship; applications are in English.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 2 2027: Open Topic on Reinvigorating and Shielding European Democracy (DEMOCRACY-09, two-stage) (closes 4 May 2027)
item.description:
European Research Executive Agency (REA) / European Commission, Horizon Europe
Deadline: 4 May 2027
Award: EUR 2.0 to 3.7 million per project; EUR 22 million indicative topic budget. Research and Innovation Action.

Two-stage open topic in the Horizon Europe Cluster 2 call 'Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society - 2027 - Two-stage' (HORIZON-CL2-2027-02-DEMOCRACY-09-two-stage). Opens 2 March 2027; first-stage deadline 4 May 2027 (short proposal), with invited full proposals in a second stage.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 2 2027: AI, Deepfakes and Democracy (DEMOCRACY-04) and The Role of Private Companies in Democracy (DEMOCRACY-07) (closes 23 Sep 2027)
item.description:
European Research Executive Agency (REA) / European Commission, Horizon Europe
Deadline: 23 Sep 2027
Award: DEMOCRACY-04: EUR 3.5 to 4.0 million per project, EUR 20 million indicative topic budget. DEMOCRACY-07: EUR 3.5 to 4.0 million per project, EUR 8 million indicative topic budget. Lump-sum Research and Innovation Actions.

Two 2027 topics in the Horizon Europe Cluster 2 call 'Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society - 2027' (opens 13 May 2027, deadline 23 September 2027), both Research and Innovation Actions with lump-sum funding.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ART4MENTAL open call for artists: VR content for mental-health support (EUR 5,000 sub-grants)
item.description: ART4MENTAL (Creative Europe project) · deadline 11 Nov 2026 · Sub-grant of up to EUR 5,000 per artist for 20 selected artists (EUR 100,000 pool), plus VR training, mentorship, a residency in the Ukrainian Carpathians and exhibition opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: make-a-thek: Mobility Scheme & Knowledge Exchange Programme (Europe + pilot countries)
item.description: make-a-thek (coordinated by Fab Lab Barcelona at IAAC, funded by Horizon Europe) · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · Mobility Scheme: EUR 1,000 flat stipend for experienced practitioners. Knowledge Exchange Programme: EUR 850 flat stipend. Up to 12 participants per track annually. No application fee.

item.title: EU CERV: European Remembrance 2026-27 (CERV-2026-CITIZENS-REM)
item.description: European Commission / EACEA (Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values Programme) · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · EUR 50,000 to EUR 500,000 per project, from an estimated call budget of EUR 28 million (EUR 14M Holocaust remembrance of Jewish victims; EUR 5M genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity incl. Roma and LGBTIQ+ victims; EUR 5M colonialism, slavery and migration; EUR 4M democratic transitions). No application fee.
